tooltip-dark-blue-text: Dark Blue: The Corresponding Period Has Completed Profit And Loss Transfer, Profit And Loss Accounts Have No Balance
tooltip-light-blue-text: Light Blue: The Corresponding Period Profit And Loss Have Been Transferred, But Profit And Loss Accounts Still Have Balance Not Fully Transferred, Need To Continue Transfer
reverse-carryover-tip: Tip: Due To Reverse Transfer Having Multiple Accounting Periods, The Financial Flow Of Business Documents Such As Sales & Purchases Can Only Go To One Accounting Period, You Need To Make A Choice, Generally The Accounting Period Currently Used.
batch-checkout-tip: Tip: Batch Checkout May Take Some Time, Please Be Patient ~
current-accounting-period: "Current" Refers To The Current Accounting Period
accounts-have-been-closed: Profits And Losses Have Been Transferred, Accounts Have Been Closed
no-need-carry-forward-this-period: No Need To Carry Forward This Period
